item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00057","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C03","C18","C02"],"selected_candidate_label":"C03","confidence":0.78,"relationship_type":"structural_functional_template","rationale":"C03 plausibly supplies a material rhetorical and drafting template: identify a coordinated campaign of false propaganda against a public program, assert that the public will not be deceived, introduce the true facts, rebut the attack with quantitative program evidence, and close by affirming the program's broad public benefits. The child compresses that machinery into a shorter REA letter. C18 similarly combines correction of hostile claims, an enumerated record of administrative accomplishments, financial comparisons, and renewed commitment, but its central purpose is explaining disapproval of legislation. C02 shares the themes of organized misrepresentation, public understanding of the facts, and confidence that Americans will not be fooled, but offers less of the child's performance-record structure.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"some people are busily circulating statements... part of a general fear psychology... our rural population will not be misled","parent_excerpt":"an extraordinary propaganda campaign... misrepresentation and distortion...
